title: Celestial Cattle Crossing
description: A surreal framed painting depicts a line of bright blue bulls with glowing horns walking across a rope suspension bridge. The bridge spans a misty, reflective landscape at sunset with mountains in the distance, while a large swirling purple portal with a hanging figure floats in the sky. The ornate frame is decorated with roots, ropes, tassels, a star, and a green hand in the corner.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a line of luminous blue bulls with glowing horns walking across a rope suspension bridge over a misty reflective landscape at sunset. Distant mountains and dramatic orange sky. A large swirling purple and gold cosmic portal floats in the sky with a small hanging figure inside. The entire scene is contained within an ornate handmade frame with purple rope, roots, tassels, a golden star, and a green hand gripping the top corner.
